eyebrow: Two real formats, both in use
code:
# syft can emit either
syft packages dir:. -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json
syft packages dir:. -o spdx-json > sbom.spdx.json

# a single CycloneDX component entry:
# { "name": "requests", "version": "2.31.0",
#   "purl": "pkg:pypi/requests@2.31.0",
#   "licenses": [{"license":{"id":"Apache-2.0"}}] }
caption: SPDX: ISO/IEC, license-compliance roots. CycloneDX: OWASP, security-first.

eyebrow: Turning the inventory into a verdict
code:
grype sbom:sbom.json

# matches every component's purl against
# vulnerability databases, reports severity
#
# run on every build so a newly disclosed issue
# in an unchanged dependency still gets caught
caption: The SBOM says what's there. A scanner says whether any of it is dangerous.
